name: ESP32_GetChipID
description: GetChipID on the ESP32: the chip as ESP.getChipModel, getChipRevision and getChipCores report it (ESP32-D0WD-V3, 301 for v3.1, two cores) and the ESP8266-style ID, the eFuse MAC's last three bytes (24:0A:C4:45:6D:62: 0x456D62), printed again after 3 s. Serial.printf's \n goes out alone.

expect.contains:
ESP32 Chip model = ESP32-D0WD-V3 Rev 301
This chip has 2 cores
Chip ID: 4549986
